environment.description: Same Flask application deployed in namespace 'api-gateway' within an Istio 1.19 mesh with strict mTLS (PeerAuthentication STRICT mode mesh-wide). An AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied to the user-service workload in 'auth-namespace' with spec.rules[0].from[0].source.namespaces=['auth-namespace'] and spec.action=ALLOW (default-deny via mesh-level AuthorizationPolicy with spec.action=DENY for unmatched). The Envoy sidecar on the api-gateway pod has a custom EnvoyFilter that strips the Authorization header before forwarding to upstream services. Additionally, the Istio ingress gateway has a RequestAuthentication resource configured with jwtRules specifying only RS256 in fromHeaders, but this applies at the gateway level before traffic reaches the pod. The application pod still receives traffic through the sidecar proxy which enforces the cross-namespace deny policy on outbound connections to auth-namespace services.

request_authentication.note: validates JWT at gateway before pod receives request
